name: RAIN;CHECK
source:
A short story set in a small, remote town about a girl just trying to get by in the middle of a rainy, tumultuous night. On this special occasion, an unexpected storm of events brews ever closer.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621860/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个发生在一个偏远小镇的短篇故事，讲述了一个女孩在一个雨夜、喧闹的夜晚试图生存的故事。在这个特殊的时刻，一场意想不到的事件风暴即将来临。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3621860/]Steam[/url]]
